A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same DM-Calib study. Their main texts, equations, figures, tables and appendices support reliable comparison despite extensive layout changes and relocation of material.

before.justification: v1 reports original camera-calibration, depth-estimation, metrology and reconstruction results, including ablations and uncertainty analyses in its appendix.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experiments and appendix analyses, with revised metric-depth results in Table 2.

M1.justification: The Camera Image representation, diffusion training, RANSAC recovery, single-step metric-depth model and reconstruction integration are unchanged. Scene conditioning and five-prediction ensembling were already documented in v1's appendix.

E1.justification: Training datasets, evaluated tasks and test scenarios are retained. ScanNet is newly listed under depth testing in v2 Table 7, but its depth evaluation already appears in v1 Table 3, retained as v2 Table 9.

E2.justification: Corresponding calibration, metric-depth and affine-invariant-depth comparisons retain the same comparators. UniDepth's calibration row is reordered, and iDisc receives an explicit citation, but neither change alters comparator membership.

E3.justification: The stated preprocessing, metrics, training budgets, batch sizes, ablation settings and pose-alignment procedures are unchanged. The newly listed ScanNet test-set size supplies previously absent documentation rather than revising a previously stated setting.

E4.justification: The representation/noise, depth-component, principal-point, camera-guidance and ensembling analyses are retained with the same evidence. The broader camera-guidance ablation referenced by v2 Section 4.5 already existed in v1 Appendix B.7 and Table 12.

E5.justification: Both versions describe averaging five camera-image predictions and report identical standard deviations in Tables 13–14. Table 14's caption changes to 'without ensembling', matching v1's existing explanatory text; no statistical procedure or reporting practice is added.

E6.justification: Table 2 revises the proposed method's δ1/SIlog results: NYU-V2 changes from 93.1/8.35 to 96.0/6.35, VOID from 73.1/15.3 to 84.0/12.8, and IBims-1 from 88.5/8.27 to 94.4/7.15. These are localized updates under unchanged stated settings; the remaining benchmark, reconstruction and ablation results are retained.

T1.justification: The Camera Image definition, diffusion objectives, intrinsic-recovery equations, depth loss, evaluation formulas and appendix Procrustes formulation are unchanged. No new theorem, proof or substantive derivation appears.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list and conclusion retain the same claims about Camera Image, accurate monocular calibration and benefits for downstream 3D tasks. Updated scores do not change these claims' scope.

C2.justification: v1 Section 4.5 attributes satisfactory depth predictions without camera guidance to pretrained diffusion priors and contrasts this with prior necessity claims. v2 removes that explanation and emphasizes guidance's importance through existing appendix evidence. The ultra-wide-angle limitation remains unchanged.

D1.justification: v2 Table 7 newly documents 83k ScanNet images as indoor RGBD depth-test data. The existing implementation instructions, hardware, hyperparameters, preprocessing and code-access information otherwise remain unchanged.

R1.justification: v2 adds discussion of Grossberg–Nayar and Schops et al. on ray-based calibration, and distinguishes Zhang et al.'s ray diffusion from monocular in-the-wild calibration. It also adds citations to iDisc, DrivingWorld and Depth Anything at Any Condition, modestly expanding research context.

P1.justification: v2 makes limited prose and affiliation edits, adopts numbered citations and reorganizes supplementary discussion, including a relative-depth subsection. The main section sequence and most wording remain intact.

P2.justification: The document is comprehensively reformatted from one column to two. The depth-training diagram, sparse-reconstruction figure, affine-depth table and pose table move into the supplement; other displays are resized or rearranged. Figure 13 gains clearer labels, and Table 14's ensembling caption is corrected. These are substantial presentation changes without new visual experiments.

improvement.justification: v2 improves coherence by reconciling Section 4.5's camera-guidance interpretation with the existing appendix ablations. Expanded research context, added test-set documentation and the corrected Table 14 caption provide further modest benefits. The scientific contribution and most evidence remain unchanged, and the unexplained Table 2 score revisions do not themselves establish a methodological improvement.
